plainTranslation:
There is real potential here, but potential only matters when it is used. What grows between you is built through participation. Every conversation, every thoughtful question, every moment of genuine curiosity adds another layer of understanding. This is not the kind of bond that has to announce itself dramatically. It develops through small, consistent exchanges, through paying attention, through helping each other find language for something that was difficult to explain before.

When this works, conversation becomes more than communication. It becomes a place where you can find yourself again.

We all have moments when our thoughts feel tangled. You know something is bothering you, but you cannot quite name it. You start talking, circling around the issue, and then this person asks a question that brings the whole thing into focus. Not because they have all the answers, but because they help you hear your own.

You may notice that after talking with them, you feel less overwhelmed by what was happening inside your head. The problem may not be solved, but it feels more manageable.

The challenge is not the conversation itself. It is using it fully. When talking feels easy, it is tempting to stay on the surface.

Stay with the conversation long enough to discover something new about each other.
